releaseNotes:
_Date: 2026-05-26_

---

### ✨ What's New

#### 🏢 Managed Configuration for Enterprise Rollouts
Compass Partner now includes a full **managed configuration** layer for IT-controlled deployments:

- **Policy-driven feature gating** can enable or disable capabilities such as Marketplace, voice, Microsoft 365, MCP, scheduler, A2A, and remote agents.
- **Managed theming** supports organisation-level colour overrides applied automatically at app startup.
- **Layered configuration resolution** now combines builtin, vendor, managed, and user settings with field-level locks.
- **Launch at startup policy** can now be enforced centrally for managed environments.

#### 💬 Sidebar Chat Mode, Projects, and Smarter Chat Lifecycle
Chat creation and navigation have been expanded into a more app-managed workflow:

- New **sidebar chat mode** supports chat-specific navigation, filtering, ordering, and menu visibility tailored to chat-first work.
- A dedicated **Projects** entry now lifts Smart Setup into its own top-level flow instead of burying it inside new chat creation.
- New chats in sidebar mode can be **auto-named**, helping empty chats become identifiable without manual cleanup.
- The chat surface now includes a **previous conversation browser** with **history replay**, so earlier ACP sessions can be reopened and reviewed in-place.

#### 🧠 Richer Chat Setup and Guidance
Starting work from an empty chat is now more guided and more useful:

- The empty state can now apply **folder profiles before first submit** and show **profile-specific prompts** and **design examples**.
- Smart Setup now includes a dedicated **Build Agent dialog** flow.
- The new **Microsoft 365 advisor** in Settings helps users understand M365 value and setup more clearly.

---

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Extensions discovery expanded** — the app can now do a quick scan for installed CLI tools beyond the preset list.
- **MCP catalog improved** — new **Perplexity** and **Glif** entries were added, with clearer tool descriptions.
- **Scheduler retention controls** — execution history can now be automatically pruned, with retention limits that can also be policy-managed by IT.
- **Cleaner chat-first UI** — chat-only mode now hides distracting sidebar actions, removes the **Audit codebase** chip, removes **Browse files**, and streamlines utility navigation.
- **Branding and layout polish** — title bar branding is hidden by default, the app label now reads **Compass AI**, and sidebar visuals have been refined.
- **Settings IA cleanup** — tabs have been reordered for a more logical flow, and CLI tools copy has been tightened.
- **Knowledge organisation improved** — the **Organization** section now appears above **My Topics**.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **History replay is safer** — input is now blocked while browsing replayed conversations, preventing accidental interaction in history mode.
- **Replay progress copy cleaned up** — a misleading loaded/total indicator was removed from chat replay.
- **Device connect flow hardened** — the connect-device QR flow now guards against invalid entry points more reliably.
- **Sidebar mode actions fixed** — **Open in Explorer** is shown correctly in chat-only mode, while pin, move, and archive actions are hidden where they do not apply.
- **Scheduler header cleanup** — redundant task-list header labels were removed for a cleaner presentation.
- **Icon consistency restored** — regenerated app icons now match tray and window branding more closely.
- **Authentication diagnostics improved** — token-related failures now surface better debugging information.

---

### ⚙️ Under the Hood

- **ADR-013, ADR-014, and ADR-015 landed** — managed configuration, sidebar chat mode, and projects dialog architecture are now formally documented.
- **Silent `.compass` initialisation** reduces setup friction during app startup.
- **Managed configuration validation hardened** — `ajv` and `ajv-formats` are now pinned for more predictable schema validation behaviour.
- **Chat lifecycle and storage groundwork expanded** — database and app-managed storage changes prepare the app for richer sidebar chat handling.

---

_Co-authored by [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/portfolio/nova.html)_
